description:
What is reishi extract | Red reishi extract factory | Famous red reishi extract

Reishi Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules

Reishi extract powder, also known as the ‘immortality mushroom‘, was first used by Chinese physicians for more than 2000 years. They believed that Reishi had a potent anti-aging effect and for these people, Reishi was a symbol of happiness, healing and well-being. Reishi is still used by herbalists in Asia and use among western naturopaths is growing! Every vegetable capsule in your Foodsporen Reishi product is richly fill for you with highly concentrate mushroom extract from the fruiting bodies of the Reishi mushroom. The Reishi mushroom extract capsules contain no less than 30% polysaccharides!

Foodsporen only uses the fruiting bodies for each of its products. No fillers or mycelia grown on grains. The Reishi capsules have a high concentration ratio of no less than 12:1.Reishi Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules

The capsules come in a sealed Miron glass bottle to ensure longevity it’s constituents. The bottle is UV protective and is consider optimal for the storage of herbs and supplements.

Number of doses:

60 capsules

Reishi extract powder product information | Reishi Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Caps

Per capsule (400mg):

Reishi 12:1 (Ganoderma Lucidum) Fruiting Body Extract 400mg

Organic Reishi Extract Usage:

1 capsule 1 or 2 times daily. Do not take with carbonated drinks or medicines.

Suitable for:

Vegetarians and vegans

Not suitable for:

During pregnancy, breastfeeding and/or an allergy to one of the ingredients. If in doubt, consult your doctor or pharmacist.

Foodsporen® Reishi capsules have been specially developed to supplement your daily diet with the healthy nutrients from the mushrooms mentioned, which are freely absorbable by the body.

Reishi extract capsules Ingredients Reishi Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Caps:

Reishi (Ganoderma Lucidum), Microcrystalline Cellulose, Hypromellose (Vegetable Capsule)
